outline: 選修介紹材料通性、分類與應用，並深入高分子生成之聚合反應、反應機構、反應動力學、熱力學、聚合物之材料構造、聚合方法、分子量之測定、分子量分佈以及一般檢測高分子特性之技術。
schedule:
週次   內容
1   Introduction of polymer chemistry
2   The morphology of polymers
3   The properties of polymers
4   Molecular weight and polymer solutions
5   The testing and analysis of polymers
6   Condensation and step polymerization
7   Free-radical polymerization
8   Ionic and coordination polymerization
9   Midterm exam
10  Copolymerization
11  Other polymerization
12  Reactions of polymers and method of polymerization
13  Biomedical application of natural and synthetic polymers
14  Final oral presentations (I)
15  Final oral presentations (II)
16  Final oral presentations (III)
17  Final overview
18  Final exam

上述課程內容將依實際上課進度調整
